blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: It is unclear how Neural Language Models (NLMs) acquire the structural meaning encoded by grammatical structures that is independent of lexical semantics. We propose a statistical learning process in which learned dependency structures themselves become new distributional units for subsequent statistical learning. Under this account, once a dependency structure is acquired, the model tracks its contextual distributions. These contextual features reflect the semantic properties of a composite structure. To test this hypothesis, we design a synthetic grammar in which each grammatical structure has distinct contextual distributions that cannot be recovered from the distributional statistics of their component tokens alone. We train a series of BERT-style masked language models on this grammar and examine their developmental trajectory. The results show that models can successfully learn the contextual distributions of composite dependency structures even though they cannot be inferred from token statistics alone. Developmental analysis further reveals a clear developmental trajectory. The learning of the dependency relations that define a grammatical structure consistently precedes the learning of its contextual features. These findings suggest that statistical learning in NLMs is not merely the accumulation of token co-occurrence statistics, but a process in which learned dependency structures become new units of distributional learning. We argue that this process provides a statistical-learning account of how NLMs solve the compositionality problem in language. Finally, we discuss the possibility that this statistical learning process provides an explanatory theory on how language cognition could emerge from pure distributional statistics.
blocks.zh: 神经语言模型(NLMs)如何获得独立于词典语义学的语法结构编码的结构意义尚不清楚. 我们建议开展统计学习进程,使学习的依赖性结构本身成为以后统计学习的新的分配单位。 在这个账户下,一旦获得附属结构,模型将跟踪其背景分布。 这些背景特征反映了复合结构的语义性质. 为了测试这个假说,我们设计了一个合成语法,在这个语法结构中,每个语法结构都有不同的背景分布,不能仅从其组成部分符号的分布统计中恢复. 我们在这个语法上训练一系列BERT风格的蒙面语言模型,并检查其发展轨迹. 结果表明,模型可以成功地学习复合依赖结构的背景分布,尽管不能仅从象征性统计数据中推断。 发展分析进一步揭示了明确的发展轨迹。 了解界定语法结构的依赖关系,始终在学习其背景特征之前。 这些调查结果表明,在NLMs中进行统计学习不仅仅是象征性的共生统计的积累,而是一个学习的依赖结构成为分配学习新单元的过程。 我们争辩说,这一进程提供了一种统计学习的叙述,说明NLM如何用语言解决组成问题。 最后,我们讨论了这样一个可能性,即这种统计学习过程提供了一种解释性理论,说明语言认知如何能够从纯分布统计中产生。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The cognitive science of NLMs endeavor to explain the language cognition and emergence of reasoning ability in NLMs. A myriad of research is dedicated on interpreting the semantic cognition (Marro et al., 2025; Vulic et al., 2020; Petersen & Potts, 2023; Hardy et al., 2023; Hofmann et al., 2025), syntactic representation (Ahuja et al., 2024; Futrell et al., 2019; Hewitt & Manning, 2019; Kim & Smolensky, 2021; Lakretz et al., 2021; Murty et al., 2023; Vázquez Martínez et al., 2023; Wilcox et al., 2022; Futrell & Mahowald, 2025; Li & Liu, 2025; Linzen et al., 2016; Wei et al., 2021; Weissweiler et al., 2023a, 2023b), and logic deduction (Huang & Chang, 2023; Mondorf & Plank, 2024; Patil & Jadon, 2025) in these models. One under-explored aspect of NLM cognition is statistical learning (Kallens et al., 2023; Kapatsinski, 2026; Bojun et al., 2026). That is, how the knowledge about these traditional concepts in human cognitive science such as syntax and semantics is constructed by simply tracking the distributional statistics in the input.
blocks.zh: NLMs的认知科学致力于解释语言认知和NLM中推理能力的出现. 在解释语义认知方面进行了大量研究(Marro等人,2025年;Vulic等人,2020年;Petersen & Potts,2023年;Hardy等人,2023年;Hofmann等人,2025年),综合表述(Ahuja等人,2024年;Futrell等人,2019年;Hewitt & Maning,2019年;Kim & Smolensky,2021年;Lakretz等人,2021年;Murty等人,2023年;Vázquez Martínez等人,2023年;Wilcox等人,2022年;Futrell & Mahowald,2025年;Li & Liu,2025年;Linzen等人,2016年;Wei等人,2021年;Weissweiler等人,2023a,2023b),以及逻辑推理(Huang & Chang,2023年;Mondorf & Plank,2024年;Patil & Jadon,2025)。 NLM认知的一个未得到充分探讨的方面是统计学习(Kallens等人,2023年;Kapatsinski,2026年;Bojun等人,2026年)。 也就是说,关于人类认知科学中这些传统概念的知识,如语法和语义学,是如何通过简单地跟踪输入中的分布统计来构建的.

blocks.en: In human cognitive science, statistical learning research examines how human learners track statistical patterns in the linguistic input and how language cognition could be constructed by these learning mechanisms (Smith, 1969; Pelucchi et al., 2009; Saffran, 2001, 2020; Saffran et al., 1996; Brown et al., 2022; Lany & Saffran, 2010, 2011; Mintz, 2002; Reeder et al., 2013, 2017; Morgan & Newport, 1981; Thompson & Newport, 2007; Wonnacott et al., 2017; Isbilen & Christiansen, 2022; Misyak et al., 2009; Perek & Goldberg, 2015, 2017; Samara et al., 2025). These studies design artificial languages that mirror certain statistical patterns in natural languages. By training humans on these artificial languages, researchers have gained lots of insight on how humans tease the intertwined statistical patterns in input and store these patterns as part of the linguistic knowledge. This constitutes part of the transition from representation to learning in cognitive science. (Perek, 2015; Pinker, 1989; Romberg & Saffran, 2010; Saffran, 2020; Tomasello, 2003, 2007; Wonnacott, 2013; Kallens et al., 2023). Rather than looking into the static representation forms alone, the focus shifted to the process of how a representation is dynamically constructed.
blocks.zh: 在人类认知科学中,统计学习研究考察了人类学习者如何跟踪语言输入的统计模式,以及这些学习机制如何构建语言认知(Smith,1969年;Pelucchi等人,2009年;Saffran等人,2001年,2020年;Saffran等人,1996年;Brown等人,2022年;Lany & Saffran,2010年;Mintz,2002年;Reeder等人,2013年,2017年;Morgan & Newport,1981年;Thompson & Newport,2007年;Wonnacott等人,2017年;Isbilen & Christiansen,2022年;Misyak等人,2009年;Perek & Goldberg,2015年;2017年;Samara等人,2025年)。 这些研究设计了与自然语言中某些统计规律相对应的人工语言. 通过对人进行关于这些人工语言的培训,研究人员获得了许多关于人类如何在输入中调侃相互交织的统计模式的洞察力,并将这些模式存储在语言知识中. 这构成认知科学从代表性向学习过渡的一部分. (Perek,2015年;Pinker,1989年;Romberg & Saffran,2010年;Saffran,2020年;Tomasello,2003年;2007年;Wonnacott,2013年;Kallens等人,2023年). 重点不是仅仅研究静态代表形式,而是转向动态代表结构的过程。

blocks.en: Statistical learning constitutes an essential component for the cognitive science of NLMs because traditional concepts in cognitive science such as syntax, semantics and reasoning are all fundamentally statistical dependencies for NLMs (Kallens et al., 2023). The representation of NLMs contains only various kinds of statistical dependencies acquired through tracking distributional statistics in the input. Functional concepts are all reflections of these statistical dependencies. One major task in the cognitive science of NLMs is thus explaining the statistical nature of these traditional cognitive science concepts in the representation of NLMs.
blocks.zh: 统计学学习是NLMs认知科学的重要组成部分,因为认知科学中的传统概念如语法,语义和推理都是NLMs在根本上的统计依赖性(Kallens等人,2023年). 国家清单的表述仅包含通过跟踪投入中的分布统计而获得的各种统计依赖。 功能性概念都是这些统计依赖性的反映. 因此,NLMs认知科学的一个主要任务是解释这些传统认知科学概念在NLM代表中的统计性质.

blocks.en: The current study aims to provide a statistical learning theory to the compositionality problem in NLM language representation (Lake & Baroni, 2018; Hupkes et al., 2020; Kim & Linzen, 2020). Compositionality problem concerns how composite semantics is derived from the component semantics. For example, how the semantics of a sentences is derived from the lexical semantics of the words in the sentence. As the idiomatic expressions in (1), the semantics of the expression contains a conditioning relation which distinguishes “the taller, the stronger” from “the stronger, the taller”. This conditioning structure is not explicitly reflected in any component lexical semantics (Culicover & Jackendoff, 1999; Nunberg et al., 1994; Croft & Cruse, 2004; Hilpert, 2019). Thus the composite semantics cannot be fully derived from lexical semantics alone. Another example is the linking problem in (2). In (2a), knowing the lexical semantics denoted by “kill” and the referent for “Mary” and “John” is not sufficient for deriving the composite semantics of the whole utterance. It would be confusing that whether Mary is the killer or John is the killer in this killing event. The representation of language has to contain a special component that specifies the mapping from syntactic elements to semantic elements (Levin & Rappaport Hovav, 2005; Baker, 1997; Dowty, 1991). In this case, this special component needs to specify that the constituent before the predicate is the agent while the constituent after the predicate is the patient. In other words, representation of language needs to contain an additional component that guides the composition of component semantics in forming composite semantics.
blocks.zh: 目前的研究旨在为NLM语言代表的构成性问题提供统计学习理论(Lake & Baroni,2018;Hupkes等人,2020;Kim & Linzen,2020). 组成问题涉及复合语义是如何从成分语义中衍生出来的. 例如,句子的语义是如何从句子中词的词性语义中衍生出来的. 作为(1)中平庸的表达方式,该表达的语义包含一种条件性关系,将"更高,更强"与"更高,更强"区分开来. 这种调理结构在任何组件词典语义中都没有明确体现(Culicover & Jackendoff,1999;Nunberg等人,1994;Croft & Cruse,2004;Hilpert,2019). 因此,复合语义不能仅从词典语义中完全推导出来. 另一个例子是(2)中的联系问题。 在(2a)中,了解“杀害”和“玛丽”和“约翰”的参考词,不足以得出整个语句的复合语义。 玛丽是杀人凶手 还是约翰是这次杀人事件的凶手 这将会令人困惑 语言的表示必须包含一个特殊的组成部分,具体区分从综合元素到语义元素的映射(Levin & Rappaport Hovav, 2005; Baker,1997; Dowty, 1991). 在这种情况下,这一特殊成分需要规定上游之前的成分是制剂,而上游之后的成分是患者. 换句话说,语言的表达需要包含一个额外的组成部分,指导组成复合语义的成分.

blocks.en: The solution to the compositionality problem in human language representation is postulating a structural semantics corresponding to each grammatical structure as the additional component (Goldberg, 2019; Croft, 2001; Langacker, 2009; Levin, 2015). In this representation form, each surface grammatical structure is directly associated with a structural semantic schema. This form-meaning correspondence specifies not only the mapping from a grammatical structure to its semantic schema, but also the mapping from syntactic elements to the corresponding semantic elements. For example, the ditransitive structure in (3) is associated with the event structure in (4), the mapping from syntactic relations to semantic relations is also illustrated in (4). This representation form also applies to more idiomatic grammatical structures. For example, the “the adj-er, the adj-er” structure in (1) simply corresponds to a semantic schema that specifies the second comparative is conditioned on the first one.
blocks.zh: 人类语言代表的构成性问题的解决方案是将一个与每个语法结构相对应的结构语义假设为附加部分(Goldberg,2019;Croft,2001;Langacker,2009;Levin,2015). 在这种表示形式中,每个表层语法结构都直接与结构语义学计划有关. 这种形式意思对应不仅规定了从语法结构到其语义结构的映射,而且还规定了从语义元素到相应语义元素的映射. 例如,(3)中的ditransitive结构与(4)中的事件结构相关,从综合关系到语义关系的映射也用(4)中说明. 这种表示形式也适用于更多的平面语法结构. 例如,(1)中的“接头人、接头人”结构仅与规定第二个比较的语义计划相对应,以第一个比较为条件。

blocks.en: For human learners, these correspondences between grammatical structures and structural semantics are acquired through the generalizations on the relations between input utterances and their real discourse context (Tomasello, 2003; Perek & Goldberg, 2017; Croft, 2003). For example, by observing sentences in (5) repetitively in real discourse context, learners could associate the ditransitive syntactic structure to the transfer of possession event structure. Further, learners could figure out the constituent before the verb is always the giver and the first constituent after the verb is always the recipient. The representation of language then consists of a huge collection of such generalizations on form-meaning correspondences. These form-meaning correspondences serve as templates when deriving the composite semantics from its lexical components, since they also entail the linking from syntactic elements in the grammatical structure to the semantic elements in the structural semantic schema.
blocks.zh: 对于人类学习者来说,语法结构与结构语义之间的这些对应是通过关于输入语句与其真实语境关系的一般化来获得的(Tomasello, 2003; Perek & Goldberg, 2017; Croft, 2003). 例如,通过在(5)中的句子在真实的语境中重复观察,学习者可以将双曲式的合成结构与拥有事件结构的转移联系起来. 此外,学习者可以在动词总是给出者之前先找出组成词,在动词之后的第一个组成词总是接受者. 语言的表述包括大量关于形式意思的通信的此类概括。 这些形式语义对应在从其语法组成部分中推导复合语义时起到模板的作用,因为它们也涉及从语法结构中的复合语义元素到结构语义语义计划中的语义元素的联系.

blocks.en: In this study we ask the question how NLMs solve the compositionalality problem. NLMs cannot learn such correspondences by attending to the semantic environment of input utterances like humans. For NLMs, the only way of acquiring semantic information of an element is tracking its distributions against other elements in its context.
blocks.zh: 在这项研究中,我们问NLM如何解决组成问题。 NLM不能通过关注像人类这样的输入语的语义环境来学习这种函证. 对NLMs来说,获取元素语义信息的唯一途径是对照其上下文的其他元素跟踪其分布.

blocks.en: We propose that there is a statistical learning process that tracks the distributional profile of composite dependency structures in the input. We hypothesize that when a composite dependency structure is learned, the model would treat this composite structure as a distributional unit and generalize on its contextual features. That means tracking the dependency relations between this composite structure and other distributional units in its context. These contextual features of a composite dependency structure reflect its semantic properties and linking rules.
blocks.zh: 我们建议有一个统计学习过程,跟踪投入中综合依赖结构的分布概况。 我们假设,当了解复合依赖结构时,模型将把这种复合结构视为分配单位,并概括其背景特征。 这意味着跟踪这一综合结构与其他分配单位在上下文中的依赖关系。 复合依赖结构的这些背景特征反映了其语义特性和连接规则.

blocks.en: We define internal dependencies are the dependency relations between token categories that constitute a composite dependency structure. Surface grammatical structures are instances of such composite structures. The syntactic relations that define a grammatical structure correspond to such internal dependency relations. We then define external dependencies as the dependency relations between a composite structure and other distributional units in its context. Collectively, these external dependency relations constitute an external distributional profile, which describes the distributional propensity of the composite structure. This external distributional profile represents the properties intrinsic to the composite structure, thus cannot be captured by the internal dependencies which contain no contextual information for the composite structure.
blocks.zh: 我们界定内部依赖关系是指构成综合依赖结构的象征类别之间的依赖关系。 表面语法结构就是这种复合结构的例子. 定义语法结构的合成关系对应这种内部依赖关系. 然后,我们将外部依赖定义为综合结构与其他分配单位在上下文中的依赖关系。 这些外部依赖关系共同构成一个外部分布图,其中描述了综合结构的分布倾向。 这种外部分布图代表了复合结构内在的属性,因此无法被内部依赖性所捕捉,因为内部依赖性没有包含复合结构的背景信息.

blocks.en: This theory makes an assumption that surface grammatical structures have distinct distributional profiles in large corpora. For example, ditransitive structure encoding “transfer of possession” meaning should have a very different distributional profile with the grammatical structure encoding “voluntary motion” events. Similarly, the grammatical structure encoding causation should have very different distributional profiles with the grammatical structures encoding the meaning “a property modifying a thing”. Even for grammatical structures encoding similar event semantics, the distributional profile should diverge as long as there is even slight difference in function. For example, even though ditransitives in (5) and datives in (6) both encode “transfer of possession” meaning, they have functional differences on discourse context. Both experimental studies and corpus studies observed that they are used in different contexts. For example, the context of ditransitives usually contains a definite recipient participant, which is previously given in discourse; the context of datives instead is inclined to contain an indefinite and newly introduced recipient participant (Rappaport Hovav & Levin, 2008; Goldberg, 2019; Bresnan et al., 2007; Theijssen et al., 2013). These nuanced functional differences are also sources of contextual distributional difference in large corpora.
blocks.zh: 这个理论假设表层语法结构在大蝎子中具有不同的分布剖面. 例如,“占有的转移”含义的二过渡结构编码应当与语法结构编码“自愿运动”事件具有非常不同的分配特征。 同样,语法结构编码因果关系应具有非常不同的分布图谱,语法结构编码的含义是“修改事物的属性”。 即使是对类似事件语义的语法结构进行编码,只要功能有微小的差别,分布式剖面就应该有所区别. 例如,虽然第(5)和(6)条中 " 占有的转让 " 两者都包含编码,但它们在语境上存在功能差异。 实验研究和体例研究都认为,它们在不同的情况下使用。 例如,ditransitives的上下文通常包含一个明确的受援方参与者,之前在论述中给出了这个上下文;而Datives的上下文倾向于包含一个无限期的和新引入的受援方参与者(Rappaport Hovav & Levin,2008年;Goldberg,2019年;Bresnan等人,2007年;Theijssen等人,2013年). 这些细微的功能差异也是大公司内部分布差异的来源.

blocks.en: In this study, we test whether NLMs form external dependencies for composite dependency structures and how the learning path in this process looks like. We design a synthetic grammar where grammatical structures are defined by internal dependencies, and these grammatical structures have unique external distributional profiles. We train a series of encoder-only Transformer models on this synthetic grammar and conduct two analysis: (a) clustering of vectors based on internal and external dependencies; (b) probability mass in sequence completion. Finally, we scale the models to demonstrate the generalizability of the findings.
blocks.zh: 在这项研究中,我们测试NLMs是否形成复合依赖结构的外部依赖性,以及这个过程中的学习路径的外观. 我们设计了一个合成语法,其中语法结构由内部依赖性定义,这些语法结构具有独特的外部分布剖面. 我们在这个合成语法上训练一系列只编码器的变形器模型,并进行两项分析:(a)根据内外的依赖性将矢量集合在一起;(b)序列完成的概率质量. 最后,我们扩大模型的尺度,以显示调查结果的普遍性。

blocks.en: The synthetic grammar:
blocks.zh: 合成语法:

blocks.en: The synthetic grammar consists of 5 categories of tokens, labeled as A, B, M, N, U. Among them, A, B, M and N categories each contain k (k=20) distinct tokens. U category contains 100 distinct tokens.
blocks.zh: 合成语法由5类符符组成,标签为A,B,M,N,U. 其中,A,B,M和N类各包含k(k=20)不同符符符. U类包含100个明显符号.

blocks.en: There are two grammatical structures in this synthetic grammar, BAA and ABA. These two trigrams are composite dependency structures defined by the dependency relations between A and B categories. M and N are contextual categories of BAA and ABA structures. M only occurs in the context of BAA structure and N only occurs in the ABA structure. Thus M tokens are the contextual features of BAA composite structure; N tokens are the contextual features of ABA structure. U tokens are the noise. Their distribution is totally random.
blocks.zh: 这个合成语法中有两个语法结构,BAA和ABA. 这两个三克是A类和B类的依赖关系所定义的复合依赖结构. M和N是BAA和ABA结构的上下文类. M只在BAA结构中发生,N只在ABA结构中发生. 因此,M符是BAA复合结构的背景特征;N符是ABA结构的背景特征. U标志是噪音。 它们的分布是完全随机的。

blocks.en: The core property of the synthetic grammar is that M and N categories cannot be distinguished by their token-level distributional statistics. Both BAA and ABA structures contain two A tokens and one B token. Consequently, M and N categories cannot be distinguished by their distributions against A and B tokens. The distributional difference between M and N categories only emerge when the composite dependency structures BAA and ABA are represented as distributional units. Thus a model would only distinguish M and N categories if it attends to the external distributional profile of the composite structures.
blocks.zh: 合成语法的核心属性是,M类和N类无法以其符号级分布统计来区分. BAA和ABA结构都包含两个A符号和一个B符号. 因此,M类和N类无法用它们相对于A和B标志的分布来区分。 M类和N类之间的分配差异只有在综合依赖结构BAA和ABA作为分配单位出现时才会出现. 因此,一个模型只有在涉及复合结构的外部分布概况时才能区分M类和N类。

blocks.en: Below is the dataset generation procedure. The dataset consists of a core set and a compensation set. In the core set, we first generate all possible BAA-M and ABA-N combinations. This creates 2k4 possible combinations. We initialize a noise dataset that contains only randomly distributed U tokens. Each sequence contains seven U tokens, there are 2k4 such noise strings in the core set in total. Then for each string, we randomly select three connected positions and replace these three positions by a trigram of either BAA or ABA. Then for the four remaining positions, we randomly select one position to replace the original U token by a contextual token. If the trigram is BAA, then the contextual token is an M token; if the trigram is ABA, the contextual token is an N token. The 2k4 strings thus exhaust all possible BAA-M and ABA-N token combinations. Each specific BAA-M or ABA-N combination occurs precisely once in this dataset.
blocks.zh: 以下为数据集生成程序. 数据集包括一套核心数据集和一套补偿数据集. 在核心集中,我们首先生成所有可能的BAA-M和ABA-N组合. 这创造了2k4可能的组合. 我们初始化了只包含随机分布的U令牌的噪声数据集. 每个序列包含7个U令牌,核心集中共有2k4个这样的噪声弦. 然后对每一个字符串,我们随机选择三个相连的位置,用一个三格的BAA或ABA来取代这三个位置. 然后对于剩下的四个位置,我们随机选择一个位置,用一个上下文的标志来取代原来的U标志. 如果三格是BAA,那么背景符号是M符号;如果三格是ABA,背景符号是N符号. 2k4字符串因此用尽了所有可能的BAA-M和ABA-N符号组合. 每一个特定的BAA-M或ABA-N组合在本数据集中精确地发生一次.

blocks.en: To this point, the core set introduces a negative dependency between M and N categories since they never co-occurs. We thus create a compensation set to offset this negative dependency to ensure M and N has no dependence in the whole dataset. We set the compensation set to contain 3k4 strings, thus the whole dataset contains 5k4 strings. These compensation strings is initialized to contain only seven randomly distributed U tokens. We insert M and N tokens in the compensation set to create controlled co-occurrence of M and N to offset the negative dependency as described below.
blocks.zh: 至此,核心集在M类和N类之间引入了负面依赖性,因为它们从不共聚. 因此,我们建立一套补偿办法,以抵消这种负面依赖,确保M和N不依赖整个数据集。 我们设定补偿集包含3k4字符串,因此整个数据集包含5k4字符串. 这些补偿字符串被初始化,只包含七个随机分布的U令牌. 我们在补偿中插入M和N符号,以产生M和N受控的共同发生,抵消下文所述的负面依赖。

blocks.en: We define P(M) as the proportion of sequences containing an M token in the complete dataset of 5k4 sequences. The same applies to P(N). Under independence, the joint probability must satisfy P(M,N)=P(M)P(N). In the core set, k4 sequences contain M and the other k4 contain N. Thus, relative to the complete dataset, the core set contribute k4/5k4=0.2 to P(M) and 0.2 to P(N), whereas it contributes 0 to P(M,N) because M and N never co-occur here. The compensation set is designed to remove this negative dependency. We set the whole dataset marginal probabilities to P(M)=P(N)=0.4, which requires P(M,N)=0.16. This indicates 16% of all sequences contain both M and N token. For these sequences, we insert one random M token and one random N token. Because the core set already contributes 20% sequences with M token and 20% sequences with N token, the compensation set need to additionally contributes 4% M-only sequences and 4% N-only sequences to ensure the marginal probability P(M)=P(N)=0.4. For M-only sequences, we randomly select one M token and insert it to the noise base; for N-only sequences, we randomly select one N token and insert it to the noise base. The complete dataset therefore consists of 40% core sequences, 16% M-N co-occurrence sequences, 4% M-only sequences, 4% N-only sequences, and 36% noise sequences containing only randomly distributed U tokens. This is illustrated in table 1.
blocks.zh: 我们把P(M)定义为在5k4序列的完整数据集中包含一个M令牌的序列比例. P(N)也是如此。 在独立的情况下,联合概率必须满足P(M,N)=P(M)P(N). 在核心集中,k4序列包含M,其他k4序列包含N. 因此,相对于完整的数据集,核心集为P(M)贡献k4/5k4=0.2,为P(N)贡献0.2,而为P(M,N)贡献0,因为M和N从未在此共同存在. 这套补偿办法旨在消除这种负面依赖。 我们把整个数据集的边际概率设定为P(M)=P(N)=0.4,这需要P(M,N)=0.16. 这表明所有序列的16%同时包含M和N的符号. 对于这些序列,我们插入一个随机M令牌和一个随机N令牌. 因为核心集已经用M令牌贡献了20%的序列,用N令牌贡献了20%的序列,所以补偿集需要额外贡献4%的M-只序列和4%的N-只序列,以保证边际概率P(M)=P(N)=0.4. 对于M-只序列,我们随机选择一个M令牌并插入噪声基;对于N-只序列,我们随机选择一个N令牌并插入噪声基. 因此,完整的数据集包含40%的核心序列,16%的M-N共聚序列,4%的M独占序列,4%的N独占序列,36%的噪音序列只包含随机分布的U令牌. 表1对此作了说明。

blocks.en: In the examples, each capital letter is a category of tokens. Token positions are randomized independently in every sequence and therefore are not fixed. The composition gives P(M) = P(N) = 0.40 and P(M,N) = 0.16

blocks.en: The core set and compensation set are combined and shuffled as a whole dataset. In the final dataset, there is no dependency between M and N categories. The only potentially learnable dependency relations in this dataset are the internal dependencies that define BAA and ABA structures, and the external dependencies BAA-M and ABA-N.
blocks.zh: 核心数据集和补偿数据集合并,整体数据集进行洗牌. 在最后的数据集中,M类和N类之间没有依赖关系. 这个数据集中唯一可能学习到的依赖关系是定义BAA和ABA结构的内部依赖,以及外部依赖BAA-M和ABA-N.

blocks.en: We then create a control dataset. Based on the existing experimental dataset, we replace all BAA trigrams by ABA trigrams. The dataset then contains only one grammatical structure ABA. Both M and N tokens are contextual tokens of ABA structure. In this case, there is no distributional difference between M and N categories at all. We expect to see that for the controlled dataset, models cannot distinguish M and N category. Instead, models would believe M and N tokens together form one category, which constitutes the external distributional profile of the ABA structure. But for the experimental dataset, we expect to see that models would clearly distinguish M and N categories since they are the contextual categories of different composite structures.
blocks.zh: 然后我们创建一个控制数据集。 基于现有的实验数据集,我们用ABA三克取代所有的BAA三克. 数据集随后只包含一个语法结构ABA. M和N两个符都是ABA结构的上下文符. 在这种情况下,M类和N类之间根本没有分配差别。 我们期望看到,对于受控数据集,模型无法区分M类和N类. 相反,模型会认为M和N的令牌一起构成一个类别,这构成了ABA结构的外部分布剖面. 但对于实验数据集,我们期望看到,模型会明确区分M类和N类,因为它们是不同复合结构的背景类别.

blocks.en: (7) a. Experimental set: BAA–M; ABA–N b. Control set: ABA–M; ABA–N
blocks.zh: (7) a. (中文(简体) ). 实验集:BAA-M;ABA-N b. 控制装置:ABA-M;ABA-N

blocks.en: In training, we randomly split the whole dataset into 90% training set and 10% validation set. This prevents the model from seeing all BAA-M and ABA-N combinations. To capture the unobserved data, the model has to generalize on the distributional propensity.
blocks.zh: 在训练方面,我们随机将整个数据集分为90%的训练集和10%的验证集. 这使得模型无法看到所有的BAA-M和ABA-N组合. 为了捕捉未观测到的数据,模型必须概括分布倾向.

blocks.en: 2 Results
blocks.zh: 2 结果

blocks.en: 2.1 Vector analysis
blocks.zh: 2.1 病媒分析

blocks.en: We train an encoder-only transformer model on this synthetic grammar using Masked Language Modeling (MLM). The model has 8 Transformer layers, 8 Attention heads, and an embedding dimension of 32 (8L-8H-32D). During training, we randomly mask two tokens in each sequence. Training loss is calculated on these two masked positions. The model is trained for 100,000 iterations and is saved after each 200 iterations. This gives us 501 model states in a developmental sequence. For the vector analysis, we extract the Value vectors from all attention heads in the first Transformer layer and concatenated all head-specific vectors into one. This is done for all tokens in the vocabulary. Vectors are extracted from all saved learning stages, so that we could look into how the clustering of these vectors changes in the course of development. After extracting all the vectors, an auto-encoder is trained to reduce the dimensions of vectors to 2D.
blocks.zh: 我们使用Masked语言建模(MLM),在这个合成语法上训练一种只有编码器的变压器模型. 该模型有8个变形器层,8个注意头,嵌入维度为32(8L-8H-32D). 在训练期间,我们随机为每个序列中的两个符号遮掩. 培训损失按这两个蒙面职位计算。 该型号为10万次迭代训练,每200次迭代后保存. 这给了我们501个模式状态 一个发展序列。 对于矢量分析,我们从第一个变形器层中的所有注意力头中提取值矢量,并将所有头特异性的矢量压缩成一个. 这是针对词汇中的所有符号的。 矢量是从所有保存的学习阶段中提取的,这样我们可以研究这些矢量的集合在发展过程中是如何变化的. 提取出所有向量后,训练出一个自动编码器,将向量的尺寸降低到2D.

blocks.en: Another encoder-only Transformer model is trained on the control language following the same MLM strategy. This model shares the same architecture and hyper-parameters with the model trained on base language. This model is trained for 1,500,000 iterations, which is 15 times more than the base model. The vector extraction and dimensionality reduction technique are also consistent.
blocks.zh: 另一种只有编码器的变形器模型按照相同的MLM策略进行控制语言的培训. 这个模型与接受过基础语言训练的模型共用相同的架构和超参数. 此型号为1,500,000次迭代训练,比基准型号多15倍. 矢量提取和维度降低技术也是一致的。

blocks.en: Figure 1 illustrates the clustering change of the base model throughout the learning path. At the initial stage of learning, there is no clustering. After 4,000 iterations training, the model starts to distinguish A and B categories in vector representation. This is the sign for learning internal dependencies since these two categories are defined by their dependency relations in these two grammatical structures. At this moment, the model fails to distinguish M and N tokens. It makes M and N tokens as a single cluster. After 39,200 iterations of training, the model successfully categorized M and N tokens into two distinct clusters. A motion chart is created to show the full learning path. Click here to view the motion chart.
blocks.zh: 图1显示了整个学习过程中基模型的集群变化。 在学习的初始阶段,没有集群. 经过4000次迭代训练,该模型开始在矢量表示法中区分A类和B类. 这是学习内部依赖性的标志,因为这两个类别是由它们在这两种语法结构中的依赖关系所定义的. 此时,模型未能区分M和N符号. 它使M和N符号作为一个单一的集群. 经过39 200次重复培训,该模型成功地将M和N符号分为两个不同的组。 创建一个运动图来显示完整的学习路径. 点击这里查看运动图 。

blocks.zh: 图1:基础语言模型一级V-载体表述的发展变化:类别在初始化时重叠,A和B分4000步,M和N分离分出39200步.

blocks.en: Figure 2: First-layer V-vector projections for the control-language model at the initial and minimum-validation-loss checkpoint; A and B are separated, whereas M and N remain overlapping.
blocks.zh: 图2:在初始和最低验证-损失检查站对控制语言模型的一级V-载体预测;A和B是分开的,而M和N仍然是重叠的。

blocks.en: Figure 2 shows the clustering of the model trained on the control language at the initial state and the stage with lowest validation loss. Click here to view the full motion chart. At minimum validation-loss stages, the model learned to categorize A and B tokens. But even though training length is prolonged 15 times, the model still fails to categorize M and N tokens in all checkpoints. Instead, the model forms a cluster that contains both M and N tokens. This indicates that the model is aware that M and N tokens are different from U tokens. This is expected because U tokens are totally randomly distributed, but M and N tokens are dependent on A and B tokens. The contrast between the experimental language model and the control language model proves that the categorization on the M and N tokens in the experimental language model is indeed based on the contextual features of BAA and ABA composite structures, rather than on lexical dependencies.
blocks.zh: 图2显示在初始状态和阶段受过控制语言培训的模型的集群情况,验证损失最低。 点击这里查看完整的运动图 。 在最少的验证-损失阶段,模型学会了将A和B符号分类. 但尽管训练时间延长了15次,该型号仍然未能在所有检查站对M和N标志进行分类. 相反,该模型形成了一个包含M和N两个符号的集群. 这表明模型意识到M和N的符号与U的符号不同. 这是由于U符完全随机分布,但M和N符则依赖于A和B符. 实验语言模型与控制语言模型的对比证明,实验语言模型中对M和N符号的分类确实基于BAA和ABA复合结构的背景特征,而不是词汇依赖.

blocks.en: 2.2 Probability mass in sequence generating
blocks.zh: 2.2 序列生成的概率质量

blocks.en: We create four sets of testing sequences. First two of them are designed to test the learning of internal dependencies, the last two are for external dependencies. All these strings are engineered from the strings in the original validation set, so none of them has been observed in training before. They are illustrated in (8) and (9). For the two sets of internal-dependency testing strings, we first find all strings containing BAA and ABA trigrams in the base validation set. We then replace all M and N tokens in these strings by random U tokens. So these strings only contain BAA and ABA trigrams at random positions. Then we mask the token in the middle position of these trigrams. This creates two kinds of trigram structures of B-MASK-A and A-MASK-A. They occur at random positions in each string. For the A-MASK-A testing strings, the target category is B; for the B-mask-A testing strings, the target category is A.
blocks.zh: 我们创造了四组测试序列。 其中前两部旨在测试内部依赖性的学习,后两部用于外部依赖性. 所有这些字符串都是从原始验证集中的字符串中设计出来的,因此在之前的训练中都没有观察到. 例子见(8)和(9)。 对于两套内部依赖性测试字符串,我们首先在基础验证集中找到包含BAA和ABA三克的所有字符串. 然后我们把这些字符串中的所有M和N符号都替换为随机的U符号. 因此这些字符串只包含随机位置的BAA和ABA三格法. 然后我们掩盖这些三维图的中间位置上的符号. 这创造了B-MASK-A和A-MASK-A的两种三角结构. 它们在每个字符串的随机位置发生. 对于A-MASK-A测试字符串,目标类别为B;对于B-mask-A测试字符串,目标类别为A.

blocks.en: For the external-dependency testing, we again use strings in the original validation set as base. We first find all BAA and ABA strings. We then eliminate 4 kinds of strings: (a)strings starting with BAA trigrams, (b)strings ending with ABA trigrams (c) BAA strings where an M token immediately precedes the BAA trigram, (d)ABA strings where an N token immediately follows the ABA trigram. For the remaining strings, we preserve the M and N tokens as contextual cues. For BAA strings, we mask the final A position and the position before the B token. This creates a MASK-B-A-MASK structure. For the ABA strings, we mask the first A position and the position after the final A position. This also creates a MASK-B-A-MASK structure. If the context of the MASK-B-A-MASK structure contains an M token, the target of prediction is A category tokens in the second MASK position. If the context of MASK-B-A-MASK structure contains an N token, the target of prediction is A tokens in the first MASK position.
blocks.zh: 对于外部依赖性测试,我们再次使用原验证集中的字符串作为基础. 我们首先找到所有的BAA和ABA串。 然后,我们删除4种字符串:(a) 从BAA trigram开始的字符串;(b) 以ABA trigram结束的字符串;(c) 在BAA trigram之前立即有一个M符号的BAA字符串;(d) 在ABA trigram之后立即有一个N符号的字符串。 对于剩下的字符串,我们保留M和N符号作为背景提示. 对于BAA字符串,我们掩盖了最终A位置和B符号前的位置. 这创造了MASK-B-A-MASK结构. 对于ABA字符串,我们掩盖了第一个A位置和最后A位置之后的位置. 这也创造了MASK-B-A-MASK结构. 如果MASK-B-A-MASK结构的上下文包含一个M令牌,预测的目标就是第二个MASK位置的A类令牌. 如果MASK-B-A-MASK结构的上下文包含一个N符号,预测的目标就是第一个MASK位置上的A符号.

blocks.en: We conduct testing on each saved learning stage. In each stage, we randomly draw 512 testing strings of each type to do testing. For each testing string, we look into the probability distribution generated by the model on the target positions. We define probability mass as the sum of the probability for all tokens in the target category. For internal-dependency testing strings with A-MASK-A strings, we sum the probability of all B tokens at the masked position as the probability mass for B category; for testings with B-MASK-A strings, we sum the probability of all A tokens at the masked position. For external dependency testings with M tokens as contextual cues, we sum the probability of all A tokens at the second MASK position; for external-dependency testings with N tokens as contextual cues, we sum the probability of all A tokens at the first MASK position. If a dependency relation is learned, we expect to see the probability mass of the target category gradually approaches one in the learning path. That means the model is assigning almost all probability to tokens from the target category.
blocks.zh: 我们在每个保存的学习阶段进行测试。 在每个阶段,我们随机绘制512个每个类型的测试字符串进行测试. 对于每个测试字符串,我们研究模型在目标位置上产生的概率分布. 我们把概率质量定义为目标类别中所有符号的概率之和. 对于使用A-MASK-A字符串进行内部依赖性测试的字符串,我们将所有在遮蔽位置上的B符号的概率作为B类的概率质量进行总和;对于使用B-MASK-A字符串进行的测试,我们将所有A符号在遮蔽位置上的概率进行总和. 对于以M令牌作为上下文提示的外部依赖性测试,我们在第二个MASK位置对全部A令牌的概率进行总和;对于以N令牌作为上下文提示的外部依赖性测试,我们在第一个MASK位置对全部A令牌的概率进行总和. 如果了解了依赖关系,我们期望看到目标类别的概率质量逐渐接近学习道路上的一个。 这意味着该模型将几乎所有概率都分配给来自目标类别的符号.

blocks.en: At each learning stage, we average the target category probability mass across 512 sampled testing strings within each probe set. Further, we train one hundred models with the same configuration but different seeds for initialization and data shuffling. The probability mass is then averaged across the one hundred models. The result is presented in Figure 3.
blocks.zh: 在每一个学习阶段,我们平均 目标类别概率质量 在512抽样测试字符串 在每个探测器集。 此外,我们培训了100个型号,配置相同,但种子不同,用于初始化和数据疏导。 然后在100个模型中平均得出概率质量。 结果见图3。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Probability mass analysis through the learning path. Solid lines show the mean probability mass, ribbons show the 95% confidence interval.

blocks.en: We add a control testing. For the same set of testing strings, we replace the context token M/N by a random U token. For the original testing strings with M and N tokens, we calculate the difference between the probability mass of A category at the target position and the non-target position. blocks.en: The results suggest that NLMs indeed acquire external dependencies of composite dependency structures. The probability mass for all four sets of testing strings approached one in the end of learning. Note that these testing strings contain BAA-M and ABA-N combinations that never observed in training. Therefore, the only possible interpretation to the probability mass pattern in figure 3 is that the model formed productive categories defined by the distributional relations between the composite structures and their contextual tokens.
blocks.zh: 结果表明,国家自然保护机制确实获得了综合依赖结构的外部依赖性。 所有四套测试字符串的概率质量在学习结束时接近一个. 注意这些测试字符串包含在训练中从未观察到的BAA-M和ABA-N组合. 因此,对图3中概率质量模式的唯一可能解释是,模型形成了由复合结构与其上下文符号之间的分配关系所定义的生产类别。

blocks.en: Further, the result suggests that the learning of internal dependency does not fully precede the learning of external dependency. The model does not first fully acquire the internal dependencies and then starts generalizing on the external dependencies. Instead, the model starts the learning of external dependencies at the time it first detects internal dependency relations. In other words, once the model found a distributional bias from the noise, the model would start tracking the contextual distribution of this distributional bias. Albeit, internal dependencies are generally learned earlier than external dependencies.
blocks.zh: 此外,结果显示,学习内部依赖性并不完全优先于学习外部依赖性。 该模型不首先完全获得内部依赖,然后开始概括外部依赖. 相反,模型在首次发现内部依赖关系时开始学习外部依赖性. 换句话说,一旦模型从噪声中发现分布偏差,模型就会开始跟踪这种分布偏差的背景分布. 虽然内部依赖性一般比外部依赖性要早.

blocks.zh: 2.3 扩大模型

Specifically, we compare three masked language models with increasing model capacity: 4L-4H-16D, 8L-8H-32D, and 8L-8H-64D. Here, L denotes the number of Transformer layers, H denotes the number of attention heads, and D denotes the hidden dimension.

The probability mass is averaged across 512 sampled testing strings within each probe set. We then average this value across the one hundred seeds for each architecture. blocks.en: 3 Discussion
blocks.zh: 3 讨论情况

blocks.en: The observations in this study confirm the hypothesis that composite dependency structures constitute distributional units in the statistical learning of NLMs. In this process, NLMs form distributional profiles for dependency structures by tracking their contextual features. This statistical learning mechanism allows models to learn the properties that belong to the dependency relations, which cannot be inferred from the properties of component tokens.
blocks.zh: 本研究中的意见证实了一种假设,即复合依赖结构构成NLM统计学习中的分布单位. 在这个过程中,NLMs通过跟踪其背景特征来形成依赖结构的分布图谱. 这种统计学习机制允许模型学习属于依赖关系的性质,这些特性不能从组件符的属性中推断出来.

blocks.en: The synthetic grammar in this study creates a radical scenario where two composite dependency structures are defined by the same set of tokens. This creates a clean statistical environment, in which contextual features of the two composite dependency structures are disentangled from token-level distributions. Natural language corpora are much more complex statistical environments. Distributional profiles of composite dependency structures may overlap with the distributional profiles of component tokens or token categories. It is possible that token x has a global repulsive relation to token y in the whole dataset, but the relation becomes locally attractive when y occurs in certain composite dependency structures. Further, it is also possible that the repulsive relation between x and y becomes locally stronger when y occurs in certain composite dependency structures. Further investigation is needed to establish how NLMs learn in these more complex statistical environments.
blocks.zh: 本研究中的合成语法创造了一种激进的情景,即两个复合依赖结构由同一组符来定义. 这就创造了一个干净的统计环境,在这种环境中,两个复合依赖结构的背景特征与符号级分布脱节. 自然语言corpora是更复杂的统计环境. 复合依赖结构的分布图谱可能与组件符号或符号类别的分布图谱重叠. 在整个数据集中,符号x可能与符号y有全球反感关系,但当y出现在某些复合依赖结构中时,关系就变得具有本地吸引力. 此外,当y出现在某些复合依赖结构中时,x和y之间的反感关系也有可能变得更强. 需要进行进一步的调查,以确定国家清单如何在这些更为复杂的统计环境中学习。

blocks.en: Another potential statistical structure that is not present in our synthetic grammar is the dependency relations between composite dependency structures. Since composite dependency structures are distributional units in the statistical learning of NLMs, the contextual features of a composite dependency structure are very likely to subsume its dependencies against other composite dependency structures. In other words, dependency structures might attract or repulse each other in large dataset. This suggests that the statistical environment in natural language corpora might be much more complex than merely token dependencies.
blocks.zh: 我们合成语法中没有的另一个潜在统计结构是复合依赖结构之间的依赖关系. 由于综合依赖结构在国家统计学习中是分布单位,因此综合依赖结构的背景特征很可能包含与其他综合依赖结构的依赖关系。 换句话说,依赖性结构可能在大型数据集中相互吸引或击退。 这表明,自然语言中的统计环境可能比象征性依赖要复杂得多。

blocks.en: Further, the current study only demonstrates one level of the nesting between internal dependency relation and external dependency relation. Namely when a dependency relation is learned, it serves as an internal dependency and the model will learn its external distributions. A potential extension is recursive nesting: when an external dependency is learned, a larger composite dependency structure might be formed, where this external dependency becomes one of the internal dependencies that define this larger composite dependency structure. So the model could further track the external dependencies of the new larger composite dependency structure. This recursion predicts that there are latent dependency relations that cannot be observed directly in a dataset. An example is illustrated in (figure 11). To learn the outer dependency relation ABC-D, the model has to learn the inner dependency and second-level dependency first. These inner dependencies are the building blocks to the outer dependencies. The current experiments do not test recursion directly; they establish only the first step required by such process.
blocks.zh: 此外,目前的研究仅表明内部依赖关系与外部依赖关系之间的一个层次。 即当了解依赖关系时,它就成为内部依赖,模型将学习其外部分布. 潜在的延伸是递归性筑巢:在了解外部依赖性后,可能形成更大的复合依赖性结构,这种外部依赖性成为决定这种更大的复合依赖性结构的内部依赖性之一. 因此该模型可以进一步跟踪新的更大的复合依赖结构的外部依赖性. 这种重现预言,在一个数据集中无法直接观察到潜在的依赖关系。 一个例子见(图11)。 为了学习外部依赖关系ABC-D,模型必须首先学习内在依赖和二级依赖. 这些内在依存是外在依存的构件. 目前的实验不直接测试复发;它们只确定了这种过程所要求的第一步。

blocks.en: Figure 11: recursion of internal-external dependency nesting
blocks.zh: 图11:内外部依赖性筑巢的复发

blocks.en: The meaning of such dependency recursion is nested event structures. For example, consider the question in (10). To generate the logical answer to this prompt, models need to draw on three levels of representations. First, the lexical semantics of tokens. Second, the semantics of the three grammatical structures in the three sentences. This corresponds to the first level of dependency nesting, which captures the event structures encoded in the grammatical structures. Third, models need to have representations for the global event structure, which captures the relations between the smaller event structures encoded in grammatical structures. In other words, to understand the whole text, models need to learn the semantic relations between these component sentences. The sentences, which were the composites in the first layer of nesting, become the components in the second layer of nesting. This hypothetical recursion might constitute a statistical learning approach to emergence, namely why tracking distributional statistics in large corpora could derive language intelligence. The basis of the reasoning ability of LLMs might be such event structures that capture the event structures beyond sentences. This prediction is not examined in the current study.
blocks.zh: 这种依赖性重现的意义是嵌套事件结构. 例如,在(10)中考虑这一问题。 要产生这个迅速的逻辑答案,模型需要利用三个层次的表示. 第一,词典上的语义词典. 第二,三句中三个语法结构的语义. 这对应了第一级依赖性筑巢,它捕捉语法结构中编码的事件结构. 第三,模型需要对全局事件结构进行表示,它能捕捉在语法结构中编码的较小的事件结构之间的关系. 换句话说,为了理解整个文本,模型需要学习这些组成句子之间的语义关系. 句子是第一层筑巢中的复合物,成为第二层筑巢中的组件. 这种假设的重复可能构成对出现的一种统计学习方法,即为什么追踪大公司中的分布统计可以得出语言智能. LLMS的推理能力的基础可能是能够捕捉到句子以外的事件结构的事件结构. 本研究报告没有审查这一预测。

blocks.en: (10) “The taller a person is, the more sophisticated that person is in linguistics.
blocks.zh: (10) “一个人越高,在语言学上就越复杂。

blocks.en: Mary is taller than John.
blocks.zh: 玛丽比约翰高。

blocks.en: So who is more sophisticated in linguistics?”
blocks.zh: 那么在语言学上谁更精密呢? “

blocks.en: In summary, this study proposed a statistical learning mechanism of tracking the external distributions of composite dependency structures. The findings demonstrate that NLM statistical learning is not merely the accumulation of token-level co-occurrence statistics, but a process in which learned dependency structures become new distributional units for further learning. This statistical learning mechanism potentially helps NLMs solve the compositionality problem in the representation of grammar and potentially constitute a statistical learning account to emergence. It offers a new way of describing language representations in NLMs that is grounded in statistical structure rather than predefined linguistic categories. This perspective draws insight from statistical learning theory in human cognitive science, providing a common framework for understanding how abstract linguistic knowledge may emerge from statistical distributions.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,这项研究提出了跟踪综合依赖结构外部分布的统计学习机制。 调查结果表明,NLM统计学习不仅仅是象征性的共生统计的积累,而是学习的依赖结构成为进一步学习的新分配单位的过程。 这种统计学习机制可能帮助NLM解决语法表述中的构成性问题,并可能构成统计学习账户直至出现. 它提供了一个以统计结构而不是预先界定的语言类别为基础的NLM语言表述的新方式。 这一视角从人类认知科学中的统计学习理论中吸取洞察力,为理解抽象语言知识如何从统计分布中产生提供了一个共同的框架.

blocks.en: 4 Materials and Methods
blocks.zh: 4. 材料和方法

blocks.en: 4.1 Synthetic grammar implementation
blocks.zh: 4.1 合成语法的执行

blocks.en: The conceptual design and composition of the artificial languages are described in the main text. The implementation contained 180 ordinary lexical tokens: 20 tokens in each of the A, B, M, and N categories and 100 U tokens. Four additional identifiers represented the [PAD], [UNK], [CLS], and [MASK] tokens. Category labels were used only to generate the dataset and evaluate the trained models; they were not shown to the models during training. Before model input, the identifiers of the 180 ordinary tokens were randomly shuffled so that category membership could not be inferred from adjacent numerical identifiers.

blocks.en: 4.2 Architecture and training for vector analysis models
blocks.zh: 4.2 矢量分析模型的结构和培训

blocks.en: The main model contained 8 Transformer layers, 8 attention heads, a hidden dimension of 32, and an intermediate dimension of 64. The two scaling models were 4L/4H/16D with an intermediate dimension of 32 and 8L/8H/64D with an intermediate dimension of 128. All models used dynamic exact-two-position masking, hidden and attention dropout probabilities of 0.1, AdamW, a minibatch size of 64, a constant learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} , and weight decay of 0.01. For the reported developmental visualizations, checkpoints from steps 0–100,000 were retained every 200 updates, yielding 501 states including initialization. The displayed models used seed 1000. The architecture-matched ABA-only control model shown in Figure 2, 8, 10 used the same model and optimization settings for 1,500,000 updates. It was saved every 1,000 updates, yielding 1,501 states including initialization.
blocks.zh: 主型号包含8个变形器层,8个注意力头,隐藏的尺寸为32,中间尺寸为64. 两种缩放模型为4L/4H/16D,中间尺寸为32和8L/8H/64D,中间尺寸为128。 所有模型都使用了动态精确的二位掩体,隐藏和注意力的失落概率为0.1,亚当W,小批量尺寸为64,持续学习率为1×10−4 1\times 10^{-4},体重衰减为0.01. 对于所报告的发展可视化,每200个更新点就保留了0至100 000步的检查站,产生了501个州,包括初始化。 展示的模型使用了种子1000. 图2,8,10中显示的架构匹配的ABA唯一控制模型,在1,500,000个更新中使用了相同的模型和优化设置. 它每1 000个更新就节省了1 501个状态,包括初始化。

blocks.en: 4.3 Architecture and training for Probability-mass analysis models
blocks.zh: 4.3 概率质量分析模型的架构和培训

blocks.en: The probability-mass analysis used three separately trained architectures: 4L/4H/16D with intermediate dimension 32, 8L/8H/32D with intermediate dimension 64, and 8L/8H/64D with intermediate dimension 128. Training used dynamic exact-two-position masking, AdamW, a minibatch size of 512, a constant learning rate of 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} , weight decay of 0.01, and hidden and attention dropout probabilities of 0.1. Each model was trained for 200,000 updates and saved at initialization and every 500 updates thereafter, yielding 401 states per model.
blocks.zh: 概率质量分析使用了三个单独训练的架构:中间尺寸32的4L/4H/16D,中间尺寸64的8L/8H/32D和中间尺寸128的8L/8H/64D. 训练使用动态精确的二位面罩,AdamW,小批量大小512,常年学习率为5×10−4 5\times 10×4}体重衰减0.01,隐藏和注意力辍学概率为0.1. 每个模型都接受了200 000次更新培训,并在初始化时保存下来,此后每500次更新一次,每个模型产生401个状态。

blocks.en: 4.4 Developmental Value-vector analysis
blocks.zh: 4.4 发展价值影响分析

blocks.en: Token vectors were extracted from every saved model state. At each checkpoint, every A, B, M, N, and U token identity was placed in the fourth position of a seven-token probe, with a fixed U token occupying the remaining positions. We extracted the Value projection,
blocks.zh: 从每一个保存的模型状态中提取了托肯向量. 每个检查站,每个A,B,M,N,和U标志性身份被置于一个七孔探测器的第四位置,一个固定的U标志性物占据其余位置. 我们提取了价值预测

blocks.en: V = X ​ W V + b V , V=XW_{V}+b_{V},
blocks.zh: V = X W V + b V , V =X W _{ V + b _{ V } V → X W + b _{ V , V =X W _{ V _{ V _{ V } } } } },

blocks.en: at the target position in the first Transformer layer. Because this projection is computed from the embedding-level input before the first contextual attention operation, it constitutes a static context-free representation. For the main model, each attention head contributed a four-dimensional vector. The 8 head-specific vectors were concatenated to produce one 32-dimensional vector for each token.
blocks.zh: 在第一个变形器层中的目标位置。 由于这种预测是在第一次上下文注意操作前从嵌入级输入计算出来的,它构成了静态无上下文的表示. 对于主模型来说,每个注意力头都贡献了一个四维矢量. 8个头特异的矢量被调和,以产生每个令牌一个32维的矢量.

blocks.en: For each trained model, vectors from all token identities and all saved checkpoints were extracted. A separate autoencoder was then fitted for each model. For the main model, the autoencoder had the architecture 32 → 16 → 2 → 16 → 32 32\to 16\to 2\to 16\to 32 , with GELU activations. It was optimized using AdamW, a learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} , weight decay of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , a minibatch size of 512, and mean-squared reconstruction error. It is trained for half epoch, with no early stopping or drop out.
blocks.zh: 对每一个训练有素的模型,都提取出所有象征性身份和所有节省的检查站的矢量。 然后为每个型号安装了单独的自动编码器。 对于主型号,自动编码器有架构32 → 16 → 2 → 16 → 32 32 → 16 → 2 → 16 → 32 → 16 → 32 ,带有 GELU 激活功能. 它被优化使用 AdamW, 学习率为 10− 5 10− 5} 体重衰减 10− 4 10− 4} 小批量大小为 512 , 以及 中等重建错误。 它经过半个世纪的训练,没有提前停止或辍学。

blocks.en: The two-dimensional autoencoder coordinates were used only for visualization. Because separate autoencoders were fitted to different models, the orientations, scales, and absolute distances of axes should not be compared across panels.
blocks.zh: 二维自动编码器坐标仅用于可视化. 由于不同的自动编码器被安装在不同型号上,不应将轴的定向,鳞片和绝对距离作跨面板的比较.

blocks.en: 4.5 Probability-mass evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.5 概率质量评价

blocks.en: The four probe families used to assess internal and external dependencies are described in the main text. Each probe retained metadata identifying its source sequence, motif location, masked position or positions, target category, and, for external-dependency probes, the target side. Probe strings were constructed from held-out sequences and were not used for model training.
blocks.zh: 用于评估内外依存关系的四个探险家族在正文中有所描述. 每个探测器都保留了元数据,以识别其源序列、动机位置、遮蔽位置或位置、目标类别,对于外部依赖性探测器,则识别目标方。 探测线是根据被搁置的序列构建的,没有用于模型培训。

blocks.en: For a masked position (j), logits were converted to probabilities using the softmax function. The probability mass assigned to target category (C) was calculated as
blocks.zh: 对于一个蒙面位置(j),使用软max函数将logits转换为概率. 分配给目标类别(C)的概率质量计算为:

blocks.en: PM ⁡ ( C ∣ j ) = ∑ w ∈ C P ⁡ ( w ∣ j ) . \operatorname{PM}(C\mid j)=\sum_{w\in C}P(w\mid j).
blocks.zh: PM QQ (C Q j ) = ∑ ∈ ⁡ ∣(w j ).\operatorname{PM}(C\mid j) =\ sum_{w\in C}(w\mid j).

blocks.en: Thus, the measure evaluated the total probability assigned to the appropriate lexical category rather than the probability of a single token. At every checkpoint, 512 probe strings from each of the four probe families were evaluated. Probability mass was first averaged across probe strings within each model and checkpoint. These model-level means were then averaged across the 100 independently initialized models. Confidence intervals were calculated across model-level means, treating the model—not the individual probe string—as the independent unit.
blocks.zh: 因此,该措施评价了分配给适当语法类的总概率,而不是一个符号的概率。 在每个检查站,对来自四个探险家庭的512个探险弦进行了评估. 每个模型和检查点的探测弦之间,概率质量首先平均。 这些模型层面的手段随后被平均适用于100个独立初始化的模型。 计算了模型一级手段之间的信任间隔,将模型——而不是单个探测器串——视为独立的单元。

blocks.en: 4.6 Scaling analysis and reproducibility
blocks.zh: 4.6 放大分析和可复制性

blocks.en: For the scaling analysis, dataset generation, dynamic masking, optimization, checkpointing, probe construction, probability-mass calculation, and aggregation were held constant across architectures. Only the number of Transformer layers, number of attention heads, and hidden dimension were changed. Each architecture was trained under multiple random seeds, and model-level results were aggregated using the same procedure as for the main architecture.
blocks.zh: 对于缩放分析,数据集生成,动态遮盖,优化,检查,探针构造,概率质量计算,以及汇总等各个架构均保持恒定. 只有变形器层数,注意头数,以及隐藏的维度被改变. 每个架构都是在多个随机种子下培训的,模型层面的结果采用与主架构相同的程序进行汇总.
